description: Defines classes and methods for constructing and manipulating rtnetlink messages used for network configuration via netlink sockets, including link, address, route, and rule messages.

classes.name: RtnetlinkMessage
classes.description: Base class for constructing rtnetlink messages, managing message headers and attributes.

classes.name: LinkMessage
classes.description: Derived class for link-level configuration messages.

classes.name: AddressMessage
classes.description: Derived class for address-level configuration messages.

classes.name: RouteMessage
classes.description: Derived class for routing table messages.

methods.name: RtnetlinkMessage
methods.description: Constructor initializing the message with header info.

methods.name: AppendAttribute
methods.description: Adds an attribute to the message.

methods.name: BuildIoVec
methods.description: Creates an iovec array for sendmsg.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Static method to create new message instances for link, address, route, or rule.
